title: Show encoder capability evidence in Settings WebView
summary: Render existing backend encoder capability report evidence in the Settings Media Output tab as read-only encoder/backend availability annotations.
reason: Phase 6 encoder breadth still needed WebView capability threading after the backend settings workspace exposed encoder_capability_report.
behavior_before: The Settings workspace could return encoder_capability_report, but the WebView did not surface those descriptor capability rows or report status to the operator.
behavior_after: The Settings Media Output tab shows a read-only Encoder Capability Evidence panel and video-builder guidance lines from encoder_capability_report without running probes, filtering choices, saving settings, or changing encoder selection.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_inventory_docs tests.webview.test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary -q -> 26 tests OK after updating DOM manifest inventory
apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --changed -> refreshed changed summaries
apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --check -> current summaries verified
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to remove the Settings encoder capability evidence panel, renderer helpers, DOM inventory updates, docs/status updates, static test addition, and regenerated summaries. This does not require media, queue, publish, or settings-state recovery because the change is read-only UI evidence.
